Armitage title says 'FIGGIO DESIGN'. Pattern clearly Market; backstamp not shown.

lots.working: keep_max: lowest close SOLD = $55 (Gowans Market teapot alone, Aug 2026, inside 24 months). $55 / 1.22 = $45.08, rounded down to $45 (all-in $54.90). The lot holds the same teapot plus three extra pieces, so the teapot sale is a floor, but the lot's pieces have small chips. flip_max: likely resale from sold evidence about $55 hammer at a Tasmanian room; less about 15% seller commission ($8.25) and $0 postage (local auction resale) = $46.75; / 2.44 = $19.16, rounded down to $15. Flip margin is thin.
